note: Scope registry for clinical conditions. A condition may later become a disease manifold, but in one inference pass the same axes must not be explained twice.

chronic_kidney_disease.rationale: CKD changes renal laboratory base measure. If CKD is later modeled as f_CKD, that manifold should explain renal axes instead.

systemic_lupus_erythematosus.rationale: SLE can be background autoimmune context for TTP now, but may later become its own disease manifold.

autoimmune_disease_background.rationale: Generic autoimmune background can alter inflammatory and renal base measure without implying a full active autoimmune manifold.

immunosuppression.rationale: Immunosuppression changes the patient's response capacity and diagnostic visibility.

transplant_status.rationale: Transplant status is a patient-context modifier unless a transplant complication manifold is explicitly modeled.

recent_antibiotic_exposure_or_healthcare.rationale: Recent antibiotic or healthcare contact changes resistance prior, not the sepsis vector field by itself.

diabetes_mellitus.rationale: Diabetes can be a background metabolic/infection-risk modifier until a diabetes manifold is modeled.

pregnancy.rationale: Pregnancy changes normal ranges for multiple axes and should not be represented as a disease manifold.

liver_cirrhosis.rationale: Cirrhosis changes hepatic/coagulation base measure; if later modeled as f_CIRRHOSIS, avoid double-counting those axes.

age.rationale: Age changes baseline physiology and frailty without being a disease manifold.
